project_type: Next.js 16 App Router with TypeScript, React 19, Prisma 7 + PostgreSQL
build_system: npm + Next.js + Prisma. vercel.json specifies buildCommand: 'prisma generate && next build'. No migrations directory exists - schema changes use prisma db push.
test_framework: No test framework set up - project has no test files
test_command: No tests exist. Verify with npm run build only.
verification_instructions: Run 'npm run build' in /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit. All pages must compile without errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/generated/prisma/ is generated by 'prisma generate' (postinstall hook). Do NOT edit directly.
setup_instructions: npm install (triggers prisma generate via postinstall). No database available in sandbox - use build verification only.
environment_constraints: No PostgreSQL database available in sandbox environment. Cannot run prisma migrate or prisma db push. Schema changes must be validated by ensuring prisma generate + next build succeeds. The lazy prisma proxy pattern means DB access is only attempted at runtime, not build time. createMany doesn't work reliably - use individual creates. Use Promise.allSettled for bulk operations, NOT $transaction.
contribution_requirements: Push directly to main. All API routes need try/catch with error messages in response body. Error messages must be shown in UI. LLM calls should gracefully degrade if no API key.

key_patterns.db_access: import { prisma } from '@/lib/db' - lazy proxy, safe at build time
key_patterns.api_routes: Next.js App Router route handlers in src/app/api/. All use try/catch, return NextResponse.json(). Params are: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
key_patterns.pages: Client components ('use client') using useState/useEffect for data fetching. Server components for static pages (page.tsx at root).
key_patterns.styling: Tailwind CSS 4. bg-gray-50 page bg, white cards with border-gray-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm, purple-600 primary actions, headers bg-white border-b border-gray-200 px-6 py-4, max-w-5xl mx-auto
key_patterns.components: In src/components/. Functional components with TypeScript interfaces for props.
key_patterns.navigation: Each page has its own header with nav links (no shared layout nav)

directory_structure.src/app/: Next.js App Router pages and API routes
directory_structure.src/app/api/: API route handlers (jobs, experience, resume, skills, phrases, etc.)
directory_structure.src/components/: Shared React components (AddJobForm, JobCard, ExperienceCard, etc.)
directory_structure.prisma/: Schema file (no migrations dir - uses db push)
